text: The new onboard radio SHALL keep the active voice call running when the train moves between coverage areas, or recover quickly enough that the driver does not need to redial manually.
sourcePassage: The new onboard radio should keep the active voice call running when the train moves between coverage areas, or at least recover quickly enough that the driver does not need to redial manually.

text: The system SHALL provide a way for the dispatcher to reach the driver even if the train unit was restarted recently and services are not fully back yet.
sourcePassage: Need a way for the dispatcher to reach the driver even if the train unit was restarted recently and not all services are fully back yet.

text: The cab equipment SHALL behave in a familiar way for drivers coming from GSM-R, especially for emergency and group communication functions.
sourcePassage: Please make sure the cab equipment still behaves in a familiar way for drivers coming from GSM-R, especially for emergency and group communication functions.

text: The system SHALL support operation in tunnels and difficult coverage areas better than today, with fewer dropped sessions reported by operations.
sourcePassage: System should support operation in tunnels and difficult coverage areas better than today, with fewer dropped sessions reported by operations.

text: The system SHALL prioritize emergency voice, operational voice, and non-critical data so that the critical traffic always gets through first.
sourcePassage: We need clearer prioritisation between emergency voice, operational voice, and non-critical data so that the critical traffic always gets through first.

text: If the radio loses the main network, it SHALL automatically try the available backup path without requiring manual intervention from the driver.
sourcePassage: If the radio loses the main network, it should automatically try the available backup path without requiring manual intervention from the driver.

text: The system SHALL provide an easier way to see which communication service is active and whether the terminal is running on the primary or fallback connection.
sourcePassage: There should be an easier way to see which communication service is active and whether the terminal is running on the primary or fallback connection.

text: The system SHALL support remote software update capability for the communication unit in a way that does not interfere with train operation.
sourcePassage: Please support remote software update capability for the communication unit, but only in a way that does not interfere with train operation.

text: The system SHALL provide logs detailed enough for incident investigation, especially around failed registrations, interrupted calls, and service handovers.
sourcePassage: We need logs detailed enough for incident investigation, especially around failed registrations, interrupted calls, and service handovers.

text: The system SHALL provide a simpler fault view that shows whether the issue is network-related, onboard-related, or configuration-related.
sourcePassage: The maintenance team would like a simpler fault view that shows whether the issue is network-related, onboard-related, or configuration-related.

text: Identity handling SHALL remain stable when the same trainset is used across different national or operator environments.
sourcePassage: Identity handling needs to remain stable when the same trainset is used across different national or operator environments.

text: The radio SHALL not present drivers with technical alarms that they cannot act on; alarms SHALL be filtered or grouped more intelligently.
sourcePassage: The radio should not present drivers with technical alarms that they cannot act on; alarms should be filtered or grouped more intelligently.
